Let discover the hidden beauty of its ever rich traditional cultures, foods and history” The perfect location Our surroundings Primely located on famous animated Bao Khanh Lane, Hanoi Pearl Hotel is a perfect choice for coming to enjoy Hanoi Old quarter, local lives, night market, walking streets and everything at the central. It just takes you few steps to Legendary Hoan Kiem Lake and couple of walking minutes to many other city attractions as: Ngoc Son Temple, Thang Long Water Puppet Theatre, Weekend Night Market St. Joseph's Cathedral and the unique local daily street activities. + - The Candles Restaurant The Candles Restaurant is at the first floor of Hanoi Pearl Hotel with elegant ambiance and enchanting décor, guests embark on an adventure of genuine traditional Vietnamese cuisine. The harmonious of traditional specialties and international culinary delights will guiding guests through a unique flavorful adventure with gorgeous taste. Pearl Lounge Present on roof top floor, Pearl Lounge impresses with marvelous view of Hoan Kiem Lake, Cathedral Church and green tree-lined old streets. Savour the Vietnamese freshly fruits, juices, Pearl Signature cocktails or enjoy fabulous grill menu with premium wine for your evening’s perfection. Sip a fresh brewed Vietnamese coffee or The Pearl High Tea with premium selection from Dimah brand also unforgettable moment in your trip. P - spa P-spa is the Hanoipearlhotel’s hospitality, a peaceful space inside the hotel where you can find the Purity of Pearl. Fulfill your unforgettable experience at Hanoi Pearl hotel by melting the soul into the Pearl therapies at P-spa with unique traditional Vietnamese’s rituals mixed modern wellness techniques plus premium selection of natural herbs and oils. P-spa inspires well being lives.
